input.summary:
Schoolhouse cloakroom furnished in parts/room-4.mjs: coat-hook fence pegs on the west column (y4), a boot bench (spruce stair seat plus a fence post carrying a standing lantern) on the east column; both doorway lanes and the west headroom stay clear.
make.sh writes a whole build.nbt; the part line shows 5 placed, no REFUSED or off-palette blocks.
`mcd room` says OK: 8 of 8 floor cells reachable, min light 10, no dark cells, and `mcd fit` reports nothing wrong for the room.
left: elements.md line 'coat hooks (inside)' is built here, but the same line's porch shell, mangrove door pair and pediment belong to P2/P4, so I did not tick it.
plan.md has no per-room checklist line, so I ticked nothing there.

room.png was rendered before the roof and the other shells were merged, so the ceiling at y5 and the window/door framing are not yet seen; a lamplighter should re-check the lantern once the roof is in.
The room render shows the outside shell only from above, so the furnishing cannot be judged by eye yet.

waste.what: Found the lantern and coat-rail placement by trial: a hanging lantern with nothing above it, a standing lantern on a stair top (which the fit check refuses), and a fence peg at head height that blocked the x16 headroom.
waste.tool: `mcd room` could print the valid lantern and stand spots for a cell (block under, headroom kept) before I write, not only after a build.

waste.what: Worked out the cell-by-cell headroom and walk for the 4x2 cloakroom by hand.
waste.cost: about 8 cells reasoned in my head; no tool call.
waste.tool: A `layers` dry-run flag that prints the walk and fit verdict of a legend+rows block before it writes into the build.

waste.what: Checked the ceiling (y5) and whether the window/door framing sits clear of the furniture by reading plan.md, not by a tool.
waste.tool: `mcd room` could print the room's bounding shell (the walls, windows and ceiling it sees) alongside the floor grid.

companions.task: After the roofs and openings merge, re-check the hanging lantern's support and the light on the 8 cloakroom cells, and confirm no lantern sits over a doorway.
